smell_rule_desc: A file-scope function counts as having deeply inlined callee bodies when its body contains copied statement fragments (normalized against identifier/number/string renaming) of at least two distinct other functions of the same file, with fragments that are substantive (at least 5 matched statements and at least half of the fragment source's statements; at least 30 matched tokens and at least 40% of the fragment source's tokens) and laid out mostly contiguously (longest copied run of at least 6 statements). The rule is evaluated on top of a clang-tidy back-end pass (readability-function-size with a case-specific line threshold of 4) that semantically parses the unit and yields the per-function structural inventory used as the analysis gate.
